1: Chapter 1: A Visitor on a Rainy Night

The rain in Qingshi Town had been falling for three whole days. Lin Xiaoyu's older sister had left for the capital in the spring, and ever since, Lin Xiaoyu had been the only one tending the small medicine shop in town.
After dark, she closed the doors and windows, counted the day's earnings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
She had just lain down when hurried knocking sounded from downstairs, followed by a man's voice: "Is anyone there?"
Outside stood a young man drenched to the bone, his left arm wrapped in strips of cloth that were seeping blood. He said his name was Bai Yun and that he belonged to the Azure Dragon Society.
"I need my wound dressed," Bai Yun said in a low voice. "I can pay. Is three thousand five hundred wen enough?"
He took out a letter wrapped in oiled paper from inside his clothes. "This letter must reach Qingfeng Temple before the eighteenth day of the fifth month."
While she bandaged him, he said with a wry smile, "If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a girl's door in the middle of the night, she would certainly be jealous."
Lin Xiaoyu did not take his money. She only said, "Tomorrow morning, I'll take you up the mountain."
2: At first light, the two set off. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back, with dry rations, medicinal herbs, and an old umbrella inside.

Halfway up the mountain, they met an old man chopping firewood, Zhou Dashan. The old man set down his axe and said in a low voice that the previous evening three outsiders had been asking at the town entrance about a wounded young man.
“Xiaoyu, you two take the small path,” Zhou Dashan said. “The main road isn’t safe.” Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The small path was narrow and slippery. Lin Xiaoyu walked in front, every step firm and steady. Bai Yun followed behind without saying a word.

By noon the rain had stopped, and the mist in the mountains slowly lifted, revealing the roof of Qingfeng Temple in the distance. At the temple gate stood a nun named Zhao Qiuyue, the guestmaster in charge of receiving visitors.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, looked at the red seal on the flap, and nodded. “The abbess has been waiting for this letter for 2 years.”
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, “I owe you my life.” Lin Xiaoyu smiled. “Then next time you come, help me fix the roof of my medicine shop.” Bai Yun stayed at the temple.
At dusk, Lin Xiaoyu went down the mountain alone. By the time she got home it was already dark. She lit the lamp and sat behind the counter for a long time.
